description: Olungereza lwe lulimi lw’egwanga mu Uganda: mu masomero, mu ofiisi ne mu mawulire, era lwogerwa mu nsi nyingi.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Lusoga courses (#129) from the Luganda text, with low confidence in Lusoga; needs a native-speaker review.

why.title: Olulimi lw’**esomero n’omulimu ogwa buli lunaku.**
why.text: Olungereza lwe lulimi lw’egwanga mu Uganda. Lukozesebwa mu masomero, mu kooti, mu ofiisi ne ku yintaneti. Luyige osobole okusoma, okufuna omulimu, n’okwogera n’abantu okuva mu nsi yona.

cards.title: Ku somero
cards.text: Tegeera abasomesa n’ebitabo, era oyitire wagulu mu bigezo.

cards.title: Ku mulimu
cards.text: Wandiika, yogera era okole n’abantu ab’enjawulo n’obwesige.

cards.title: Mu nsi yona
cards.text: Yogera n’abagenyi, otambule era osome ku yintaneti.

landing.farewell: Thank you very much — weebale inho.
landing.audience: Aboogera Olusoga abaagala okuyiga Olungereza okuva ku ntandikwa: abayizi, abakozi, n’abazade abaagala okuyamba abaana baabwe ku somero.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’enamba, oluvanyuma ab’omu maka, emere, akatale, obude, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.
